x: Despite the filthy weather, there was a good muster of club supporters and if our clothes were damped, at least our spirits were not. By his grand performance, Eric becomes this year's holder of the Jimmy Bellchamber Cup.
Jimmy Bellchamber, the Club's first great long distance walker, finished 2nd in the Brighton and Back race in 1921 in 20hrs. 53mins. 35secs. and so became our first Centurion.
